method: Independent standard-library calculation of all 36 serialized raw HTTP response rows and ordered key/value parser of complete server logs; no original comparator/auditor imported or called.

off.all_layer_observation_scope: Off: layer-zero prefill/HTTP observed; global layer records disabled. Zero layer records is not zero decode or all-layer verification.
off.reset_failed_note: Already-unloaded unit; successful stop and exact final not-found verified.

on.all_layer_observation_scope: On selected prefill and true decode: exact ordered 48-layer groups directly observed.
on.reset_failed_note: Already-unloaded unit; successful stop and exact final not-found verified.

effective_input_rate_definition: Fixed actual input tokens divided by arithmetic mean TTFT; descriptive client input rate, not isolated prefill kernel throughput or mean of individual rates.
reused_evidence: Passed quality/host/numerical and independent history132-file review retained by immutable review hashes and matching source digests. No repeated tests or history metrics recomputation.
controller_rc3_meaning: Valid NO_GO from completed evidence contracts; outer continuation completed normally with cleanup_unknown false.
limitations: Three fixed-order repeats per tier, off then on; no significance, confidence interval, tail estimate, workload-wide guarantee, or favorable additional sample.

Caches persist within each service; only each arm starts payload-cold. Separate evalscope/tokenizer process per request adds interrequest idle; historical reference timings are not used for acceptance.
TTFT and latency are serialized evalscope HTTP observations, not new independent clocks. Decode=(actual_output-1)/(latency-TTFT). Mean values never replace strict first/later-max/min gates.

Outputs match all repeats, paired arms and frozen historical SHA exactly. This is compatibility evidence, not all-intermediate numerical equality. Actual output usage is trusted rather than recounted from UTF-8 text/SSE events.
HTTP status codes are absent in the exporter schema; success flags, completion usage, finish reason, request identity and timing boundaries are retained instead. No status was invented.

Off layer-zero/HTTP evidence does not observe all-layer decode; on contains 9072 candidate prefill and 220464 true decode layer records. No singleton tail occurs in these six lengths; passed history boundary evidence remains the source for singleton behavior.
Global decode logging differs between arms. No speculative log overhead is subtracted and small observed regressions do not establish a statistically significant regression or its cause.

Cold mincore endpoints, configured isolation properties and terminal cleanup receipts were checked; raw resource monitor samples were not read. 16GiB memcg is not physical-RAM proof. Separate final protection is scoped and not continuous machine-wide absence.

A valid history NO_GO permanently bars overall GO regardless of matrix values; this matrix also independently fails the three short tiers. D/next candidate remain untriggered. Documentation/push/resources/final Goal delivery are separate root responsibilities.
